q1_issues.issue: The subject of 'stop' is given Patient, but the instruction set's own cessation query for 'stopped running' pairs a stop event with Agent on its subject and Theme on the activity, so this parse will not match that QA shape.

'working' (a device functioning) is an activity rather than a stative predication in which nothing changes and nothing moves, so Experiencer is doubtful — the intransitive-subject test's stated default when unclear is Agent.

notes: The eventive 'stopped V-ing' shape (stop event plus the activity, both Past, the activity as Theme), the un-fused descriptive 'old', and the surface-form Manner adverb 'suddenly' are all as specified.
